narration.text: One of these tools generates stunning images without a single paid credit.

Coming in at number five, Ideogram is fantastic for text. It's totally free and often outperforms many paid models at incorporating text accurately into images. This makes it perfect for logos or banners.

Number four is Clipdrop. Its cleanup and uncrop tools are incredibly precise. You can magically remove unwanted objects or extend image backgrounds seamlessly, making it feel like a professional editor.
At number three, we have Leonardo AI. It consistently generates high-quality images and excels at keeping character styles the same across multiple images. This makes it a powerful storytelling tool.
Number two is Fooocus, an open-source marvel. It offers professional results with minimal effort, thanks to its super simple interface. It's like having Stable Diffusion without the complexity.

And the number one free AI image generator is DALL-E 3, available through Microsoft Copilot. It offers unmatched image quality and understanding of your prompts, completely free. You get incredible detail and coherence every time.
DALL-E 3 via Copilot truly redefines what 'free' means for AI art. Which free AI image generator do you think is best?
